poll.question: Tomorrow at 5:30 with clear skies—should the family tackle the woodshed frame while the light peaks, or make the fuel run the priority and keep the shed pace easier?

options.label: Frame first, fuel after
options.desc: Cole leads framing at first light. Fuel run once the frame is up. Ride the momentum.

options.label: Fuel first, frame second
options.desc: Get the solar charged. Framing by mid-morning. Steadier rhythm for tired bones.

options.label: Split the day
options.desc: Early fuel run, Cole back by mid-morning, then full framing push.

in_play.label: Race the winter
in_play.desc: Momentum and clear days are precious—push the big projects hard now while the weather holds.
